correctness.rationale: The path continuant identities make the unmodified grid operator nilpotent and give exact corner resolvent moments. Tensor-binomial cancellation leaves only moments at \(t=0\) and \(t=2^j-2\), \(3\le j\le b\). The matrix determinant lemma gives \(\det(zI-B_b)=z^{2n}p_b(z)\) with \(p_b(0)=1\) and \(p_b'(z)=z^{n-1}\), so the nonzero factor is squarefree. Fitting decomposition gives the \(n\)-dimensional periodic subspace and exact fixed-iterate gcd formula. Rabin irreducibility checks for \(b=3,5\) and complete trial division of \(127\) and \(2147483647\) prove the two primitive-orbit cases. Independent direct state evolution corroborates the \(3\times7\) case. No exhaustive \(2^{31}-1\)-step trajectory was simulated; the claim follows from the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: A single local feedback bit turns a nilpotent local grid rule into an explicitly counted invertible recurrent sector across an infinite width family. At \(b=5\), it converts extinction on a 93-vertex system into eventual entry with probability \(1-2^{-31}\) into one prime cycle of length \(2^{31}-1\). This is a motivated quantitative dynamical phase change rather than a routine table lookup or parameter relabelling.
